title: asunset feature manifest (features.yaml)
description: Versioned source of truth for what features exist in a deployment (docs/feature-permissions-spec.md). Keys are FGA object ids; grants are DEFAULT usersets — direct user/team grants are runtime data, never manifest entries.

features.description: Map of feature key → definition. Key format: domain.verb (lowercase, dot-separated); the key IS the FGA object id (feature:<key>). Keys never name object instances — per-object questions belong to resource relations.

description.description: Operator-facing description of what the feature gates.

enabled.description: false = declarative DECOMMISSION: reconcile sweeps EVERY grant (defaults AND runtime); runtime grants do not return on re-enable. For a reversible incident pause use the freeze API (v1.1), not this.

grants.description: DEFAULT grants as usersets. Empty = the runtime-only pattern: declared, gate-validated, granted to no one by default.

oneOf.description: Platform org usersets (resolved against the instance's single org at reconcile time).

scope.description: Declared reach per resource type (spec s11): references to REGISTERED resolvers, never inline logic. One entry per resource_type.

areas.description: Per-area declared mode vocabulary (spec s11): keys with >=3 segments must have their prefix here and their final segment in modes. Verb modes are legitimate; object instances are not.
